name: Medical University of Vienna
summary: Vienna's medical university: human medicine and dentistry, German-taught diploma degrees entered through the MedAT test.

ib.text: An IB Diploma counts as the entrance qualification. You must pass the MedAT and have German at C1 by admission; without Latin at school you pass a Latin exam in your first semesters.

notes: MedAT registration comes long before IB results: for 2026 entry it ran 2 to 31 March 2026, and the 2027 dates are not yet published.
Medicine and dentistry here are diploma degrees, not bachelor's; there is no English-taught option.
